gold.user: User wants to create a new SIP recording for a specific call using their Twilio account. They provide the Account SID and Call SID to identify the call, along with necessary parameters for the SIP recording.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response with the details of the created SIP recording, including the SID of the new recording.

gold.user: User needs to update an existing SIP recording for a specific call. They provide the Account SID, Call SID, and the SID of the SIP recording they wish to update, along with the new parameters for the recording.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success response indicating that the SIP recording has been updated, along with the updated details.
